name: It Wears My Skin
source:
In the quiet town of Blackthorn County, a date night becomes a fight for survival. Phil and his boyfriend Brick must survive a night stalked by a shapeshifter that wears familiar faces. Help Brick and Phil survive the night, or become another mask for the monster.

[From [url=https://floofy-loofy.itch.io/it-wears-my-skin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在布莱克索恩县安静的小镇，约会之夜变成了生存之战。菲尔和他的男朋友布里克必须度过一个被熟悉面孔的变形者跟踪的夜晚。帮助布里克和菲尔度过夜晚，或者成为怪物的另一个面具。

[来自[url=https://floofy-loofy.itch.io/it-wears-my-skin]itch.io[/url]]
